propositions: Zizmor workflow auditing is currently scoped to release.yml only; gerrit-verify.yaml and _build-and-test.yml (the vote-casting critical path) are not audited
SHA-pin assertions in gerrit-verify.yaml line 21 are partially false; actions/setup-python@v7 and actions/checkout@v7 use mutable tags instead of commit SHAs
Twine distribution metadata validation runs only at release, not pre-merge; adding it to _artifact-probe.yml would catch packaging defects before merge with minimal latency cost
Coverage enforcement uses a 70% global floor rather than diff-coverage on changed lines, which is the approach used by urllib3 and cryptography
CodeQL gating would add material pre-merge latency to the Verified gate; keeping it scheduled/non-gating preserves latency budget while maintaining regression detection via scheduled sweeps
